title: Corosolic acid attenuates platelet-derived growth factor signaling in macrophages and smooth muscle cells of pulmonary arterial hypertension.
authors: Yamamura, Aya; Fujiwara, Moe; Kawade, Akiko; Amano, Taiki; Hossain, Alamgir; Nayeem, Md Junayed; Kondo, Rubii; Suzuki, Yoshiaki; Inoue, Yasumichi; Hayashi, Hidetoshi; Suzuki, Susumu; Sato, Motohiko; Yamamura, Hisao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究科罗索酸在肺动脉高压中抑制PDGF信号通路，属细胞信号传导与疾病机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a progressive and life-threatening disease that is characterized by vascular remodeling of the pulmonary artery. Pulmonary vascular remodeling is primarily caused by the excessive proliferation and migration of pulmonary arterial smooth muscle cells (PASMCs), which are facilitated by perivascular inflammatory cells including macrophages. Corosolic acid (CRA) is a natural pentacyclic triterpenoid that exerts anti-inflammatory effects. In the present study, the effects of CRA on the viability of macrophages were examined using monocrotaline (MCT)-induced PAH rats and human monocyte-derived macrophages. Although we previously reported that CRA inhibited signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) signaling and ameliorated pulmonary vascular remodeling in PAH, the inhibitory mechanism remains unclear. Therefore, the underlying mechanisms were investigated using PASMCs from idiopathic PAH (IPAH) patients. In MCT-PAH rats, CRA inhibited the accumulation of macrophages around remodeled pulmonary arteries. CRA reduced the viability of human monocyte-derived macrophages. In IPAH-PASMCs, CRA attenuated cell proliferation and migration facilitated by platelet-derived growth factor (PDGF)-BB released from macrophages and PASMCs. CRA also downregulated the expression of PDGF receptor beta and its signaling pathways, STAT3 and nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB). In addition, CRA attenuated the phosphorylation of PDGF receptor beta and STAT3 following the PDGF-BB simulation. The expression and phosphorylation levels of PDGF receptor beta after the PDGF-BB stimulation were reduced by the small interfering RNA knockdown of NF-kappaB, but not STAT3, in IPAH-PASMCs. In conclusion, CRA attenuated the PDGF-PDGF receptor beta-STAT3 and PDGF-PDGF receptor beta-NF-kappaB signaling axis in macrophages and PASMCs, and thus, ameliorated pulmonary vascular remodeling in PAH.
abstract_zh: 肺动脉高压（pulmonary arterial hypertension, PAH）是一种进行性且危及生命的疾病，其特征为肺动脉的血管重塑。肺血管重塑主要由肺动脉平滑肌细胞（pulmonary arterial smooth muscle cells, PASMCs）的过度增殖和迁移引起，而包括巨噬细胞在内的血管周围炎症细胞则促进了这一过程。科罗索酸（corosolic acid, CRA）是一种天然的五环三萜类化合物，具有抗炎作用。在本研究中，使用野百合碱（monocrotaline, MCT）诱导的PAH大鼠和人单核细胞来源的巨噬细胞，检测了CRA对巨噬细胞活力的影响。尽管我们先前报道CRA抑制了信号转导与转录激活因子3（signal transducer and activator of transcription 3, STAT3）信号通路并改善了PAH中的肺血管重塑，但其抑制机制仍不清楚。因此，使用特发性PAH（idiopathic PAH, IPAH）患者的PASMCs研究了潜在机制。在MCT-PAH大鼠中，CRA抑制了重塑肺动脉周围巨噬细胞的积聚。CRA降低了人单核细胞来源巨噬细胞的活力。在IPAH-PASMCs中，CRA减弱了由巨噬细胞和PASMCs释放的血小板衍生生长因子（platelet-derived growth factor, PDGF）-BB促进的细胞增殖和迁移。CRA还下调了PDGF受体β及其信号通路STAT3和核因子-κB（nuclear factor-kappaB, NF-kappaB）的表达。此外，CRA在PDGF-BB刺激后减弱了PDGF受体β和STAT3的磷酸化。在IPAH-PASMCs中，通过小干扰RNA敲低NF-kappaB（而非STAT3）降低了PDGF-BB刺激后PDGF受体β的表达和磷酸化水平。总之，CRA减弱了巨噬细胞和PASMCs中的PDGF-PDGF受体β-STAT3及PDGF-PDGF受体β-NF-kappaB信号轴，从而改善了PAH中的肺血管重塑。
